about.text: an English, ale-washed, soft blue cheese made by Feltham's Farm from organic cow's milk. Winner of the Best British Cheese award at the 2020 Virtual Cheese Awards

sources.text: Rind-washed soft blue from organic cow milk, Feltham's Farm, Somerset; Best British Cheese 2020; ripening not stated
